chunks: From him, from Al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Yusuf, from Mu'adh ibn Thabit Al-Jawhari, from Amr ibn Jumay', from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), from his father (peace be upon him), who said:

The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'The best of your women is the one with the good scent, the one with good food, who, when she spends, spends in a good manner, and when she holds back, holds back in a good manner; she is from the workers of Allah, and the worker of Allah does not fail.'

key_terms.لَا يَخِيبُ: Does not fail / Is not in vain

ai.seo_question: What are the key characteristics of the best women according to this hadith from Tahdhib al-Ahkam?
ai.summary: Recorded in Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* within the chapter on choosing spouses, this hadith links domestic harmony to spiritual merit by defining the ideal wife through sensory pleasantness, culinary care, and balanced financial prudence. It elevates these domestic duties to the status of 'workers of Allah' (ummal Allah), implying that consistent, moderate management of household resources is a form of worship that guarantees divine reward.
